constraints.name: ck_entry_amount_ciphertext
constraints.definition: CHECK (amount IS NULL OR amount LIKE 'enc:v1:%')

constraints.name: ck_entry_list_amount_ciphertext
constraints.definition: CHECK (list_amount IS NULL OR list_amount LIKE 'enc:v1:%')

constraints.name: ck_entry_note_ciphertext
constraints.definition: CHECK (note_md IS NULL OR note_md LIKE 'enc:v1:%')

constraints.name: ck_note_priority_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (priority IS NULL OR priority IN ('p1', 'p2', 'p3'))

constraints.name: ck_note_private_ciphertext
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT is_private OR ((title IS NULL OR title LIKE 'enc:v1:%') AND (body_md IS NULL OR body_md LIKE 'enc:v1:%')))

constraints.name: ck_subscription_list_amount_ciphertext
constraints.definition: CHECK (list_amount IS NULL OR list_amount LIKE 'enc:v1:%')

constraints.name: ck_task_priority_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (priority IS NULL OR priority IN ('p1', 'p2', 'p3'))

constraints.name: ck_task_private_ciphertext
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT is_private OR (title LIKE 'enc:v1:%' AND (body_md IS NULL OR body_md LIKE 'enc:v1:%')))

constraints.name: ck_tracker_reminder_action_input_mode
constraints.definition: CHECK (reminder_action IS NULL OR reminder_action = 'open_tracker' OR (reminder_action = 'confirm_event' AND input_mode = 'event'))

constraints.name: ck_tracker_reminder_action_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (reminder_action IS NULL OR reminder_action IN ('confirm_event', 'open_tracker'))

constraints.name: ck_tracker_reminder_mode_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (reminder_mode IS NULL OR reminder_mode IN ('fixed', 'after_entry'))

constraints.name: ck_tracker_reminder_time_whole_second
constraints.definition: CHECK (reminder_time IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(MICROSECONDS FROM reminder_time)::bigint % 1000000) = 0)

constraints.name: ck_tracker_unit_matches_input_mode
constraints.definition: CHECK ((input_mode = 'quantity' AND unit IS NOT NULL) OR (input_mode <> 'quantity' AND unit IS NULL))
